content:
Greetings! I want to write a library of parser-combinators in Lean that would make it impossible to write a looping parser.

At the same time, it's crucial for me that the properties of more complex parsers be automatically derived from the properties of simpler parsers and the combinators that combine them.

Please tell me, what properties of combinators and parsers do I need to prove, and how can I attach these properties to the parser itself so that they can be combined without additional proofs?
Please give me some advice today! I'm short on time.
Take a look at how we proved in mathlib3 that the num parser behaved as expected
There were a variety of parser properties that that code added, and proofs of how certain combinators would retain those properties.
We used typeclass search to propagate those properties in the background

Thank you!
Can you give me a link?
